simple.summary: אֲפֵקָה (ʼĂphêqâh) means Aphekah , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 15 53.

definitions.full: H664. Apheqah אֲפֵקָה proper name, of a location (meaning perhaps id. ) one of a group of cities including Hebron Josh 15:53 . I. אפר (compare perhaps leap , be agile ; see אבק ).
